entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The greenery of Brenas whizzed past..."
entries.dialogueText: The greenery of Brenas whizzed past the windows of the royal train as we chugged toward Mave Nortus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was scheduled for a brief stop in..."
entries.dialogueText: I was scheduled for a brief stop in the border town before traveling to meet Wiktor Smolak in Wraclawitz, where -- with any luck -- the Zille question would be answered at last.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was scheduled for a visit to my n..."
entries.dialogueText: I was scheduled for a visit to my new intelligence hub there before traveling to meet Wiktor Smolak in Wraclawitz, where -- with any luck -- the Zille question would be answered at last.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Seated on a leather divan in my pri..."
entries.dialogueText: Seated on a leather divan in my private salon carriage, I looked once more at the Amended Zille Agreement. Letters and numbers swam before my eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Seated on a leather divan in my pri..."
entries.dialogueText: Seated on a leather divan in my private salon carriage, I looked once more at the contingency plans my councilors had suggested. Letters and numbers swam before my eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My head was gravitating towards the..."
entries.dialogueText: My head was gravitating towards the nearest cushion when the door to the carriage slid open.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel bowed as he entered. He gestu..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel bowed as he entered. He gestured toward the phone hanging on the train wall.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Sorry to interrupt, but Russello M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to interrupt, but Russello Montoro is trying to reach you. The operators should connect you in a few minutes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just what I needed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just what I needed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's about time. I have some quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's about time. I have some questions for him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very good. Thank you, Pabel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good. Thank you, Pabel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This should be fun.""
entries.dialogueText: "This should be fun."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I did tell him your time was very..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did tell him your time was very limited."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You'll have to make it quick, I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll have to make it quick, I'm afraid. We're reaching Mave Nortus shortly."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""My pleasure.""
entries.dialogueText: "My pleasure."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I must admit I'm curious what the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must admit I'm curious what the man has to say for himself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did he say what he wanted?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did he say what he wanted?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'm afraid not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid not."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""No rest for the wicked.""
entries.dialogueText: "No rest for the wicked."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel smiled sympathetically as he..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel smiled sympathetically as he entered. He gestured toward the phone hanging on the train wall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The train lurched forward, catapult..."
entries.dialogueText: The train lurched forward, catapulting us into each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He immediately took a step back and..."
entries.dialogueText: He immediately took a step back and brushed himself off.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He used the opportunity to sneak a..."
entries.dialogueText: He used the opportunity to sneak a quick kiss, then reluctantly pulled away.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""A close one, Your Majesty. If anyo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A close one, Your Majesty. If anyone had seen us, they might have thought something illegal was afoot."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'll leave you to it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll leave you to it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled shyly."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled shyly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I never got a chance to thank you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never got a chance to thank you, Your Majesty. For... everything."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Well. I'll leave you to it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well. I'll leave you to it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Pabel shut the carriage door, th..."
entries.dialogueText: As Pabel shut the carriage door, the phone began to ring.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""King Romus speaking.""
entries.dialogueText: "King Romus speaking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you want, Rusty?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you want, Rusty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Montoro.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you scared of what the Lespian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you scared of what the Lespians will do to you now that you're no longer an asset?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your Majesty. Been a while.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Been a while."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm warning you, Your Majesty. Thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm warning you, Your Majesty. This could get bad."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's fine. I have a plan.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine. I have a plan."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am fully aware of the gravity of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am fully aware of the gravity of the situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sotelato is little more than a mos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato is little more than a mosquito whining in my ear. I'll swat him before he becomes a menace."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""One of *my" former miners goes rog..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of *my" former miners goes rogue and starts making open threats against the monarchy, and you say it doesn't concern me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What exactly are you suggesting?""
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly are you suggesting?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For your information, I don't have..."
entries.dialogueText: "For your information, I don't have anything against Mr. Sotelato or his party."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough with your warnings. Adarfo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough with your warnings. Adarfo and his movement don't concern you."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Glad to hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to hear it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""He's the face of the Rizian People..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's the face of the Rizian People's Party. He's a menace already."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm offering you my help.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm offering you my help."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Really? Because it seems like he's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? Because it seems like he's got a bone to pick with you."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Would that plan happen to involve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would that plan happen to involve compromising with Sotelato and his party? If so, big mistake."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a burst of static on his..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a burst of static on his end of the line.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know that 'promotion' we were..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know that 'promotion' we were talking about a while back? Forget it. I don't need it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""There was a time I thought you and..."
entries.dialogueText: "There was a time I thought you and I were on the same page. That time's up."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know that stake you sold me in..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know that stake you sold me in Rizian Oil and Gas? You can have it back. I don't need it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""The Royal Family's been very good..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Royal Family's been very good to me. But I think our time together is coming to an end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not going to stand for this a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not going to stand for this any longer. I'm nationalizing RRG. I don't care what it costs me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You want RRG? You can have it. Wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "You want RRG? You can have it. What's left of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough. I'm instructing the Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough. I'm instructing the Rizia Imperii authorities to put you under arrest immediately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He chuckled softly."
entries.dialogueText: He chuckled softly.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You think I'm still in Rizia Imper..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think I'm still in Rizia Imperii? Cute."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's talk about this. Even if Sot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's talk about this. Even if Sotelato takes power, that doesn't automatically mean the end of you or your company."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You wouldn't leave Rizia. You'd lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't leave Rizia. You'd lose everything."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You kidding? He's got a shiny litt..."
entries.dialogueText: "You kidding? He's got a shiny little guillotine waiting for me, right next to yours."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""It's been nice knowing you, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been nice knowing you, Your Majesty. A real pleasure."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hm. I don't seem to be missing any..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hm. I don't seem to be missing anything at present."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The line went dead."
entries.dialogueText: The line went dead.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I never even got a chance to congr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never even got a chance to congratulate you on Her Highness' engagement. Bet you're one proud papa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lord willing, we shall prevail.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lord willing, we shall prevail."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""How's the war effort?""
entries.dialogueText: "How's the war effort?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Heard you're off to Zille? Can't w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heard you're off to Zille? Can't wait to see what state our mines are in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must've read the headlines. Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must've read the headlines. Rizia is on the brink of victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must've read the headlines. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must've read the headlines. It's a total disgrace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That is between me and the head of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is between me and the head of our military."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Exhausting. But Rizia will pull th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exhausting. But Rizia will pull through."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's the spirit.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's the spirit."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Great. Can't wait for that peaceti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Can't wait for that peacetime prosperity."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Nothing but respect for General Ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing but respect for General Taddeus. From death's door to bossing troops around in record time."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""As for me...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for me..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I can't say I'm too happy about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't say I'm too happy about the state of the economy."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm very glad the economy's perkin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm very glad the economy's perking up. Puts a spring in one's step."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Business could be better, but I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Business could be better, but I can't complain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You received your invitation for t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You received your invitation for the royal wedding, didn't you? Everyone's going to be there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am proud of what my daughter's u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud of what my daughter's union will accomplish for our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My daughter's marrying the love of..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter's marrying the love of her life. I am proud I let her choose her own future."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And a handsome future it is.""
entries.dialogueText: "And a handsome future it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't get your hopes up.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get your hopes up."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll give you a tour as soon as I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll give you a tour as soon as I can."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll pass your well wishes on to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll pass your well wishes on to the Princess."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Most kind of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Most kind of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd be proud of my daughter whethe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd be proud of my daughter whether she was engaged or not."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Still, must be a real load off, ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, must be a real load off, right?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I've already ordered my new tuxedo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already ordered my new tuxedo. Brown, so nobody notices when I spill soup on it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Proud and practical. Gotta admire..."
entries.dialogueText: "Proud and practical. Gotta admire it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You got your compensation. You hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "You got your compensation. You have nothing to complain about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It doesn't matter, does it? We hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter, does it? We have Aureus."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Wehzeks went crazy up there, did t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehzeks went crazy up there, did they? Ah, can't blame them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's skip to the part where you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's skip to the part where you tell me why you're calling."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A temporary setback. We've all had..."
entries.dialogueText: "A temporary setback. We've all had to make sacrifices to defeat the Palesians."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia will bounce back. We always..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia will bounce back. We always have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Numbers are misleading. We are doi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Numbers are misleading. We are doing better than ever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who cares about the state of the e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who cares about the state of the economy? What matters is that citizen welfare is better than ever."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And transform one of the most reso..."
entries.dialogueText: "And transform one of the most resource-rich countries in South Merkopa into a full-blown Malenyevist republic? Are you kidding?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you talking about Lespia and A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you talking about Lespia and ATO? Because one would think they're itching for him to overthrow me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, what are you waiting for? Te..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, what are you waiting for? Tell them to get to it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Huh. You mean that?""
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. You mean that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you're speaking metaphorica..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're speaking metaphorically. Killing Sotelato will only turn him into a martyr and strengthen his movement."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Because they'd do it, you know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Because they'd do it, you know."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know how these 'movements' rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how these 'movements' really are. 10 percent ideas, 90 percent personality cults."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""The boys from Palantor have been g..."
entries.dialogueText: "The boys from Palantor have been getting bored guarding my palace. Saying it's about time they saw some real action."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I already have Rizia's internal se..."
entries.dialogueText: "I already have Rizia's internal security forces observing Sotelato and his followers. If the movement grows too large, we will crush it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you think they can get the job..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you think they can get the job done without attracting notice?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Are you kidding? You've met 'em. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you kidding? You've met 'em. They're pros."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""People are paying attention to Sot..."
entries.dialogueText: "People are paying attention to Sotelato now because he's House Speaker. You take away that platform, his influence goes with it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""People are paying attention to Sot..."
entries.dialogueText: "People are paying attention to Sotelato now because he's the Delegate opposition leader. You take away that platform, his influence goes with it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I do have one other idea. See, I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do have one other idea. See, I was thinking..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have been thinking about doing a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have been thinking about doing away with the House of Delegates anyway. It is a useless, redundant organ, much like an appendix or a third nipple."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""A weirdly specific example. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "A weirdly specific example. But I agree."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The House of Delegates is a fine i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House of Delegates is a fine institution. I just don't believe a radical like Sotelato belongs there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The entire notion of Delegates is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The entire notion of Delegates is blasphemous. There is but one delegate that matters, and it is I, the monarch, appointed by God as His sole delegate in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He whistled."
entries.dialogueText: He whistled.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Well said.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well said."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's ridiculous. Getting rid of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's ridiculous. Getting rid of Rizia's last semblance of democracy will rile the radicals up even further."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Maybe. But they'll have a harder t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe. But they'll have a harder time finding followers."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Great. Just making sure you're on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Just making sure you're on the case."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A covert assassination that can be..."
entries.dialogueText: "A covert assassination that can be pinned on Sotelato's Arcasian enemies... I have to say, I like it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I thought you might.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you might."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Should you need my guys for some o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should you need my guys for some other purpose, I'm happy to loan 'em out anytime."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you. I haven't forgotten abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. I haven't forgotten about what I promised you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you. I haven't forgotten abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. I haven't forgotten about what you requested."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If that's what you think, I sugges..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's what you think, I suggest we neatly and quietly remove him from it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, what you're suggesting stri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, what you're suggesting strikes me as too extreme of a measure."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Look, you and I have had our diffe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look, you and I have had our differences. But I think it's fair to say Sotelato is a common enemy."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I know you're no Malenyevist. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you're no Malenyevist. It's fair to say Sotelato is a common enemy."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Some people will get mad. But with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some people will get mad. But with no one to lead them, how much harm can they do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm of the same opinion. But I don..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm of the same opinion. But I don't want to involve international interests in our domestic affairs."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We wouldn't need to reach outside..."
entries.dialogueText: "We wouldn't need to reach outside the country, strictly speaking..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can tell you for a fact that's n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can tell you for a fact that's not going to happen. Sotelato may be against the monarchy, but the Crown will protect him and his right to free speech if we have to."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I was afraid you might say that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I was afraid you might say that."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I for one am not going to stick ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I for one am not going to stick around and wait for him to use it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Just out of curiosity, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just out of curiosity, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Are you still planning on working..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you still planning on working with the reformists, now that they've fallen in line behind this guy?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You're not planning on working wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not planning on working with this guy, are you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a matter of fact, I am. I'm ful..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I am. I'm fully on board with his vision for reform in Rizia, and we will work together to put it in place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't see any other choice. His..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see any other choice. His movement is too strong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I told Manus Sazon I'd work with h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told Manus Sazon I'd work with him. But I'm having second thoughts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't tell you if I was.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't tell you if I was."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I bet you are.""
entries.dialogueText: "I bet you are."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll see after I meet with him.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll see after I meet with him."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Meet with him? You'd actually give..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meet with him? You'd actually give that commie the time of day?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Under absolutely no circumstances.""
entries.dialogueText: "Under absolutely no circumstances."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I am working with Grand Wisema..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I am working with Grand Wiseman Ignacius to bring God to this kingdom at last. Heathens such as Sotelato will tremble before us."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Huh. Well, as long as you protect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. Well, as long as you protect the sanctity of Rizian resources and the corporations that extract them, I'm on board."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Well, if you are, you should recon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if you are, you should reconsider."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Let me guess. Sazon told you that?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. Sazon told you that? Kid always did have a weak spine."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You'll have to exercise a hell of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll have to exercise a hell of a lot of authority to shut down the monster your dad created. But with RRG's help, it'll be easy."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But otherwise...""
entries.dialogueText: "But otherwise..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what do you want in exchange?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what do you want in exchange?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What're you offering?""
entries.dialogueText: "What're you offering?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need your help. As King of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need your help. As King of Rizia, I could shutter the House of Delegates at any time."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Consider it a freebie.""
entries.dialogueText: "Consider it a freebie."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Although I am still holding you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although I am still holding you to your promise. Whatever new government you have, I want a say in it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Although if you were to be so kind..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although if you were to be so kind as to offer me a spot in government once the dust settles, I'd be much obliged."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Good luck getting the nobles on bo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck getting the nobles on board with that. Even with the RPP majority, a lot of them have gotten used to their cushy Delegate seats."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Good luck getting the nobles on bo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck getting the nobles on board with that. A lot of them have gotten used to their cushy Delegate seats."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""With my connections, I can make su..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my connections, I can make sure they're well compensated for their sudden unemployment."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""With my connections, I can make su..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my connections, I can make sure the nobles who hold Delegate seats are compensated for their sudden unemployment."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And in the case any RPP members st..."
entries.dialogueText: "And in the case any RPP members start feeling litigious, they'll find every legal expert in the kingdom mysteriously occupied."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shutting down the House of Delegat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."
entries.menuText: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I firmly believe this is not the w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I firmly believe this is not the way to deal with the opposition. Thank you for calling me nonetheless."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I shut down the House of Delega..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I shut down the House of Delegates, it will be of my own volition, with my own resources."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On second thought, it seems much l..."
entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, it seems much less complicated to remove Sotelato as a threat."
entries.menuText: "On second thought, it seems much less complicated to remove Sotelato as a threat."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Great, Your Majesty. I can't wait.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great, Your Majesty. I can't wait."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can take care of my own affairs..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can take care of my own affairs without having to rely on some Arcasian thugs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I doubt I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt I will."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You're most kind.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're most kind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what will you want in return f..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what will you want in return for this act of largesse?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Oh, nothing, Your Majesty. This is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, nothing, Your Majesty. This is a win-win-win situation we're talking about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An Arcasian PMC at my beck and cal..."
entries.dialogueText: "An Arcasian PMC at my beck and call? Yes, please."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""'Course, I still expect you to hon..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Course, I still expect you to honor that promise you made to me a while back."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""'Course, I do hope you'll remember..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Course, I do hope you'll remember that one request I made a while back."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Elena isn't getting any younger. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Elena isn't getting any younger. And a world of opportunities await."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Till next time.""
entries.dialogueText: "Till next time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Static from the train telephone his..."
entries.dialogueText: Static from the train telephone hissed in my ear as he hung up.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I won't tell Antoine you called hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't tell Antoine you called him that."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""No problem, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "No problem, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I wouldn't be calling you if this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be calling you if this wasn't serious. I trust you to handle it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You do know best, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You do know best, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Talk soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Talk soon."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Great, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Don't get the wrong idea, I'm a pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get the wrong idea, I'm a peaceful man. But this will save you, me and Rizia a whole lot of grief down the line."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Listen, I don't like the idea eith..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen, I don't like the idea either. But sometimes a nice, clean hit can save you a whole lot of messiness down the line."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Anyway. I trust you know what you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway. I trust you know what you're doing."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""'Course, I still expect you to hon..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Course, I still expect you to honor that promise you made to me a while back."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""'Course, I do hope you'll remember..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Course, I do hope you'll remember that request I made a while back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When the time comes, I will honor..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the time comes, I will honor it. You will take your place in the Rizian government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How soon could they get it done?""
entries.dialogueText: "How soon could they get it done?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Not tomorrow. But hopefully soon e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not tomorrow. But hopefully soon enough."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Should you be satisfied with their..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should you be satisfied with their services, I'd be happy to loan them out for other occasions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's deal with the Sotelato probl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's deal with the Sotelato problem first. Then I'll think about your request."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will find another way to deal wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will find another way to deal with Adarfo and his band of miscreants. But I'll keep Palantor in mind for other... assignments."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your offer. But my a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your offer. But my answer is no. Palantor won't get involved in Crown affairs."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""True, true. Your maneuvering in Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "True, true. Your maneuvering in Pales has made us both rich men. Rich-er."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Can't wait to see the RRG logo fly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't wait to see the RRG logo flying over that land again."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm not complaining.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not complaining."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me guess. You think you could..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. You think you could do better if you were in charge of the economy?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""All I'm saying is Rizia needs to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I'm saying is Rizia needs to think bigger. Remember, everyone relied on our gold back in the day."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""No kidding. I've had to switch fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "No kidding. I've had to switch from Lespian caviar to Lachaven salmon roe. You know how much of a downgrade that is?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""To heck with bouncing back. We sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "To heck with bouncing back. We should be bouncing higher."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've just given the orders to infu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've just given the orders to infuse a massive amount of government money into the economy. We'll bounce back in no time."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I hope you mean that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you mean that."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's great. But welfare goes dow..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's great. But welfare goes down the tubes pretty fast if citizens don't have jobs."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'll have to trust you on that one.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll have to trust you on that one."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I just wanted to hear your voice,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wanted to hear your voice, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Specifically, I want to hear that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Specifically, I want to hear that silky baritone of yours explain why new regulations are being imposed on my company after you promised otherwise."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your Majesty, our relationship, as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, our relationship, as it were, is based on a certain understanding."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro

entries.dialogueText: "You leave me to do my business, I underwrite certain activities on the Crown's behalf."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""So tell me. What's with the sudden..."
entries.dialogueText: "So tell me. What's with the sudden urge to regulate RRG?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're upset about regulations? Be..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're upset about regulations? Be glad I haven't nationalized you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's nothing against you or your c..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's nothing against you or your company. The strikers were impeding all Rizian businesses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've got to realize what I'm up..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've got to realize what I'm up against. Rizia is perilously close to another uprising."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't understand your knee-jerk..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand your knee-jerk opposition to regulation. Why not embrace it as a positive development?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look at how much the Crown is spen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at how much the Crown is spending on businesses -- including yours. You can afford to implement these."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""It's not the costs that upset me...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not the costs that upset me. It's the breach of trust."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""See, this is what's got me worried..."
entries.dialogueText: "See, this is what's got me worried. Where's the trust between us?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""It's not the regulations per se I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not the regulations per se I'm upset about. It's the breach of trust."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Still, I do feel like there's been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I do feel like there's been a breach of trust."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Back when we were watching footbal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Back when we were watching football together, you told me there'd be a seat in government with my name on it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Now I'm wondering if I can trust y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now I'm wondering if I can trust you on that."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""The only thing that would reassure..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing that would reassure me, Your Majesty, is the knowledge that somewhere in the future there's a seat in government with my name on it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You haven't seen anything yet. Wai..."
entries.dialogueText: "You haven't seen anything yet. Wait till Rizian businesses put our stimulus money to work."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Thanks for that. Might take a whil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for that. Might take a while, but you'll get results for sure."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And I wanted to know if you had an..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I wanted to know if you had any hints about what the future has in store for us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I sang the words "I changed my mind..."
entries.dialogueText: I sang the words "I changed my mind."
entries.menuText: Sing "I changed my mind" in a silky baritone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty snorted."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty snorted.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's what I get for making deals..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what I get for making deals with His Majesty the Cut-Up."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Point is, there has been what I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Point is, there has been what I'd call a breach of trust."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know, I've really got no compl..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, I've really got no complaints with the way you've been treating me and my business."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""At that football game a couple yea..."
entries.dialogueText: "At that football game a couple years back, it sounded like you had big plans in the works. Is that still happening?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""At the football game a few years b..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the football game a few years back, it seemed like you were trying to get the reformists out of your hair."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""From what I can tell, it backfired.""
entries.dialogueText: "From what I can tell, it backfired."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And from what I can tell, you did.""
entries.dialogueText: "And from what I can tell, you did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have chosen another direction fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have chosen another direction for Rizia. A holier one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reform is still our goal. We'll be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reform is still our goal. We'll be making our move any day now, in fact."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are still set on a new constitu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are still set on a new constitution for Rizia. But it will take a while."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My big ideas took a backseat to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "My big ideas took a backseat to the war, I'm afraid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is. And when these changes happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is. And when these changes happen, you'll have a front-row seat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. But the holy transformatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. But the holy transformation of Rizia has yet to begin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Circumstances have changed. I'm no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Circumstances have changed. I'm now drafting reforms with Manus Sazon and the RPP."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reformists are nothing to me...."
entries.dialogueText: "The reformists are nothing to me. If they get too out of line, I'll crush them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reform movement will be swept..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reform movement will be swept aside once the holy transformation of Rizia begins."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not allowed to say.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not allowed to say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps in the future. I have othe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps in the future. I have other priorities right now."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sotelato might not seem like much..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato might not seem like much of a menace. But if I know my ex-employees, this could get bad."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I gave some thought to the idea of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave some thought to the idea of reform. But ultimately, I had to reject it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I see. A man's allowed to change h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. A man's allowed to change his mind, I'll grant you that."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Are you winking over there? I can'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you winking over there? I can't tell over the phone, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Perfect. I'll bring the popcorn.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. I'll bring the popcorn."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm a patient man. That said...""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm a patient man. That said..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's great news.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's great news."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Our conversation did leave me with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our conversation did leave me with certain expectations. Are they still on track to be fulfilled?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Is that so? That's very, very inte..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so? That's very, very interesting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I never wanted the reformists 'out..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never wanted the reformists 'out of my hair.' I believe they can coexist peacefully with the monarchists."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That'd be the dream, wouldn't it?""
entries.dialogueText: "That'd be the dream, wouldn't it?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hard to crush a majority, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hard to crush a majority, Your Majesty. You might need help."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Huh. Interesting change of directi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. Interesting change of direction, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All I ever wanted was stability fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I ever wanted was stability for my realm. We are closer than ever to achieving it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Inspiring words.""
entries.dialogueText: "Inspiring words."

entries.dialogueText: "I need all my focus to deal with President Smolak and Zille, and you come whining to me about a seat in government? You should feel ashamed of yourself."

entries.dialogueText: "I have not forgotten what I promised you. In time, your loyalty to me will be duly rewarded."

entries.dialogueText: "Stay loyal to me, and you will be rewarded. I give you my word."

entries.dialogueText: "What will you do with that seat? If I understood your motivations, you wanted to bring Rizia closer to ATO. That's never going to happen now."

entries.dialogueText: "It depends. Is your loyalty to money, or is it to the six pillars of Wruhecism, the one true religion?"

entries.dialogueText: I heard him clear his throat nervously.

entries.dialogueText: "Maybe not. But I still move in the same circles as before. Our business connections with ATO countries don't have to suffer the same fate as our diplomatic ones."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "And what will you do with that seat? Give free reign to the Rizian oligarchy?"

entries.dialogueText: "If we want to start calling the shots internationally, we're going to need an economy to match."

entries.dialogueText: "It's not that simple. In a truly democratic Rizia, the King doesn't appoint ministers."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro

entries.dialogueText: "But the Prime Minster does. So let's make sure he or she is someone we like."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro

entries.dialogueText: "Ashamed I was gullible enough to let the King of Rizia string me along."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I am truly, deeply ashamed, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am truly, deeply ashamed, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sorry to disturb you. And good luc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to disturb you. And good luck over in Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Rewarded how? I'm a little dense,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rewarded how? I'm a little dense, so please enlighten me on the specifics."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You're right. I'm ashamed.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. I'm ashamed."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro

entries.dialogueText: "Ashamed I stuck my neck out for you without getting something upfront first."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Assuming there's a role for me in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Assuming there's a role for me in all this, of course."

entries.dialogueText: "Stay loyal to me, and you will be rewarded. I promise you that."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Talk soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Talk soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know what I promised you. But it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what I promised you. But it's not going to be feasible in the current climate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Your role? Rusty, I have no idea what's going to happen. Count yourself lucky if RRG emerges unscathed."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hey! You can't blame a man for get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey! You can't blame a man for getting curious."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I understand...""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""As long as you understand that our..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you understand that our cooperation ends here."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sorry to bother you, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to bother you, Your Majesty. I know it's a busy day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A government position is just not..."
entries.dialogueText: "A government position is just not going to be feasible in the current climate. Sorry to disappoint you."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I understand...""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""As long as you understand that RRG..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you understand that RRG won't be able to help you going forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot be concrete about that ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot be concrete about that right now. You'll just have to trust me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""All right. I'll hold you to it tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. I'll hold you to it that we're still on the same side."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And why should I trust you, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "And why should I trust you, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are overestimating the strengt..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are overestimating the strength of this so-called movement. It'll fizzle out before long."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Okay. I hope you're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay. I hope you're right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll keep your offer in mind. Than..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll keep your offer in mind. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My reforms will be completely tran..."
entries.dialogueText: "My reforms will be completely transparent and above board. It's the only way they'll pass."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I will reach out should I sud..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I will reach out should I suddenly find myself devoid of all integrity."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Funny thing about the best-laid pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny thing about the best-laid plans, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Talk soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Talk soon."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Wishing you the best of luck. It c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wishing you the best of luck. It can't be easy, going behind your own family's back."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'll be right here by the phone.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be right here by the phone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not the reformists I'm worrie..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not the reformists I'm worried most about. It's backlash from the noble houses."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Ooh, good call. If anyone's got th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ooh, good call. If anyone's got the real power to stir up trouble, it's them."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Leaves me wondering what my role w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Leaves me wondering what my role will be in all this."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Leaves me wondering if there's sti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Leaves me wondering if there's still going to be a role for me in all this."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Our conversation back then did lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our conversation back then did leave me with certain expectations. Are they still on track to be fulfilled?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If you need any help maintaining t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you need any help maintaining the natural order in this kingdom, you know who to ask."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Assuming, of course, that there's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Assuming, of course, that there's a role for me in all this."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Do me a favor, at least. Take a pi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do me a favor, at least. Take a picture of old Smolak's face when he signs Zille back to us."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your Majesty. I can't thank you en..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. I can't thank you enough for taking my call."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He tried to keep his tone light as..."
entries.dialogueText: He tried to keep his tone light as he spoke.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Uh, my guards couldn't help but no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh, my guards couldn't help but notice some new faces around the periphery of my palace."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You do know that I'm nothing but a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You do know that I'm nothing but a humble servant of the Rizian Crown, right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alvarez told me everything. Your s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alvarez told me everything. Your secret is out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're paranoid, Mr. Montoro. Noth..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're paranoid, Mr. Montoro. Nothing's wrong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give me one reason why I shouldn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give me one reason why I shouldn't have you thrown in jail."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought so once. Now I don't kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought so once. Now I don't know what to believe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on, Rusty. We've never liked..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Rusty. We've never liked each other. But I had no idea how deep your treachery ran."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""My secret? I--""
entries.dialogueText: "My secret? I--"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Believe me, Your Majesty, I--""
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, Your Majesty, I--"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Treachery? I--""
entries.dialogueText: "Treachery? I--"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Jail? I--""
entries.dialogueText: "Jail? I--"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Paranoid, Your Majesty? I--""
entries.dialogueText: "Paranoid, Your Majesty? I--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a loud burst of static as..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a loud burst of static as we passed through a tunnel. I strained to hear what Rusty was saying.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""...I don't know what you've heard..."
entries.dialogueText: "...I don't know what you've heard from whom, but I'm on your side."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Let me prove it to you. I've got s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me prove it to you. I've got secrets they wouldn't want getting out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before we continue, you need to te..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we continue, you need to tell me everything about your cooperation with Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And who, pray tell, is 'they?'""
entries.dialogueText: "And who, pray tell, is 'they?'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You and your company are mine now,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and your company are mine now, to do with as I wish. Is that clear?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Crystal, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Crystal, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know, don't you? Lespia.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know, don't you? Lespia."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I wouldn't call it a cooperation...."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't call it a cooperation. And my contact wasn't even Lespian..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But fine. I will grant to you that..."
entries.dialogueText: "But fine. I will grant to you that my meteoric rise at RRG was not accomplished entirely on my lonesome."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""In exchange, I have occasionally a..."
entries.dialogueText: "In exchange, I have occasionally allowed RRG to serve as a financial conduit between those partners and... various other parties."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Early on in my career, certain int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Early on in my career, certain international partners took note of my ambitions and offered their assistance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you still have records of those..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you still have records of those transactions? Your life depends on this, Mr. Montoro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We know all that already. Did you..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know all that already. Did you know Lespia was trying to undermine us?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Let me tell you a secret. I made b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me tell you a secret. I made backup copies of all the paperwork. Not even my guards know where they're kept."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a tinge of desperation to..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a tinge of desperation to his voice.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""In the spirit of honesty, I will g..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the spirit of honesty, I will grant to you that my meteoric rise at RRG was not accomplished entirely on my lonesome."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But please just listen to me first.""
entries.dialogueText: "But please just listen to me first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Were you complicit in the Friendsh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were you complicit in the Friendship Day bombing? Because if you were, lives are on your hands."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I swear I had no idea what I was t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear I had no idea what I was transferring to whom. It was shell corporations inside shell corporations..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But let me tell you a secret. I ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "But let me tell you a secret. I made backup copies of all the paperwork. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I swear I had no idea. It was shel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear I had no idea. It was shell corporations on top of shell corporations..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I destroyed the evidence I had aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "I destroyed the evidence I had against Lespia as a favor to Prime Minister Alvarez. I'm not looking to incriminate our neighbors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I order you to hand over this info..."
entries.dialogueText: "I order you to hand over this information."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I wish I could, Your Majesty. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could, Your Majesty. But I can't just saunter out of my house and deliver it to you."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Not only the Lespians.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not only the Lespians."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Then let me help you out some othe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then let me help you out some other way."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We sweep this whole business under..."
entries.dialogueText: "We sweep this whole business under the rug, and I'll still have money and influence to spare. I can push anyone in any direction you want. Off a cliff, if that's your thing."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""About half of my guards from Palan..."
entries.dialogueText: "About half of my guards from Palantor are guys I trust. The others, well... I don't think they ever worked for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I ensure your protection, will..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I ensure your protection, will you be able to get me these files?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Yes. But I'll have to be damn well..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. But I'll have to be damn well protected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is what you get for betraying..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is what you get for betraying your kingdom. You deserve whatever punishment the Lespians can dream up."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Crown can afford to protect yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown can afford to protect you. But you still haven't convinced me why I should."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Crown has the manpower to prot..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown has the manpower to protect you. But you still haven't convinced me why I should."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unfortunately, the Crown has neith..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the Crown has neither the budget nor the available manpower to protect you."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If I do this for you, there's no w..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I do this for you, there's no way they're letting me live. You've got to provide me with reinforcements."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He drew in his breath."
entries.dialogueText: He drew in his breath.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Because it'd put Zille in your han..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because it'd put Zille in your hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll do whatever I have to. If you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do whatever I have to. If you have evidence Lespia was plotting against Rizia and Wehlen, we have to take it to the world stage."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And if you leave my name out of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if you leave my name out of these... revelations, I'll still have power and influence to spare."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Please, Your Majesty. This would p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. This would put Zille in your hands."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'll help you, Your Majesty. Zille..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll help you, Your Majesty. Zille is practically yours already."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I know our plans for the House of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know our plans for the House of Delegates election didn't pan out. But that wasn't my fault."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Our plans to shut the reformists o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our plans to shut the reformists out of the House of Delegates worked out, didn't they?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Our plans to get the reformists a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our plans to get the reformists a majority in the House of Delegates worked out, didn't they?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I've been telling you all along ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been telling you all along how useful RRG can be to you."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Whatever differences you and I hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever differences you and I have had in the past? Water under the bridge."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me confess something to you. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me confess something to you. I never had any intention of letting you off the hook for your crimes. I just called to hear you grovel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All I want is to hold Lespia to ac..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I want is to hold Lespia to account. Once that's done, our business is finished as far as I'm concerned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get me the evidence you have again..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get me the evidence you have against Lespia, and the Crown will make sure you don't face punishment."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Also perfectly fine, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "Also perfectly fine, Your Majesty. Whatever you want."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will not be arrested for now,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will not be arrested for now, nor do I want your evidence against Lespia. Just remember your King's benevolence, Rusty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can walk free. As long as you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can walk free. As long as you allow the Crown to use Palantor for its own purposes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you serious? You've committed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you serious? You've committed a betrayal of the highest order. Consider yourself under arrest."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I think the connection just broke..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think the connection just broke off. What'd you just say?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our security forces have your pala..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our security forces have your palace surrounded. I'd advise you not to put up a fight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You wanted protection? No place is..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wanted protection? No place is more secure than jail."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's been a real pleasure, Rusty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's been a real pleasure, Rusty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You heard me. The King has spoken.""
entries.dialogueText: "You heard me. The King has spoken."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: I pushed the button to disconnect the line.
