entries.dialogueText: "My secret? I--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need something more concrete tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need something more concrete than that. Do you have proof Lespia was trying to sabotage our energy infrastructure?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Not only that, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not only that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his voice."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his voice.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Remember that little incident in W..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember that little incident in Wehlen? Well, I'm pretty sure you-know-who was behind it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You wouldn't know that unless *you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't know that unless *you* were behind it as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia organized the Friendship Da..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia organized the Friendship Day bombing? I'm going to need some cold, hard evidence before I believe you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've already found and arrested t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've already found and arrested the responsible party, Rusty. Case closed."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Right. But see, are you *sure* the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right. But see, are you *sure* they're the ones responsible? I've got paperwork that says otherwise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We stopped that investigation, Rus..."
entries.dialogueText: "We stopped that investigation, Rusty. Case closed."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hey, I had no idea what I was doin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, I had no idea what I was doing at the time. Shell corporations inside of shell corporations and all that..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But I knew enough to make backup c..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I knew enough to make backup copies of the paperwork. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And I've got exactly that. I think.""
entries.dialogueText: "And I've got exactly that. I think."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I was dealing with shell corporati..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was dealing with shell corporations inside shell corporations... but the paperwork's all there, for someone smarter than me to decipher."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""...I think. Can't make heads or ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "...I think. Can't make heads or tails of it myself, but it's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Right. Except I've got paperwork t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right. Except I've got paperwork that says otherwise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a tinge of desperation to..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a tinge of desperation to his voice.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you scared of what the Lespian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you scared of what the Lespians will do to you if they find out we've blown your cover?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I said, case closed. I'm not inter..."
entries.dialogueText: "I said, case closed. I'm not interested in discussing this further."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a tinge of desperation to..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a tinge of desperation to his voice.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think you're bluffing. Now that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think you're bluffing. Now that Lespia's blown your cover, you're a dead man walking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about Palantor? Having a merc..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about Palantor? Having a mercenary force that's not connected to the Crown in any way could be quite useful to me in the future."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sure, we can do that, as long as y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, we can do that, as long as you and I stay on the good side of the Western powers-that-be."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Meaning all that talk about incrim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meaning all that talk about incriminating Lespia has to go out the window."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Does... does that mean I'm off the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Does... does that mean I'm off the hook?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Come on. What's Lespia going to do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on. What's Lespia going to do to me? My fate's in your hands, not theirs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The only thing that's of use to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing that's of use to me is your business. And I can have that without you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've decided I want to go after Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've decided I want to go after Lespia after all. Get me evidence against Alvarez, and I'll make sure you don't face punishment."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""All well and good, Your Majesty, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "All well and good, Your Majesty, but I'm going to need your help to keep the Lespians from coming after me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""What do you say?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you say?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My agreement with Alvarez meant not..."
entries.dialogueText: My agreement with Alvarez meant nothing. Lespia would answer for its crimes.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""There's still time to turn this ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's still time to turn this around. I believe in us."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Listen. I'm calling because I want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen. I'm calling because I want to know what you think about a certain rising star in the Rizian parliament."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am continuing with my reform pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am continuing with my reform plans. Manus Sazon and I will make sure there is a place for you in the new government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom of God will still need..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom of God will still need a financial policy. When the time comes, I will elevate you to your rightful place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Petition for treasurer during the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petition for treasurer during the next round of council appointments. I will make sure you get the position."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's all I ever wanted, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's all I ever wanted, Your Majesty. I can't wait."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sounds just about perfect, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds just about perfect, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Great, Your Majesty. Can't wait.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great, Your Majesty. Can't wait."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cleared his throat loudly."
entries.dialogueText: He cleared his throat loudly.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm sure you know that a number of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you know that a number of folks out there would very much like to see Sotelato dead and buried. And I don't just mean Rizians."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""No, no, no. That's no good.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, no, no. That's no good."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""They might revel in the instabilit..."
entries.dialogueText: "They might revel in the instability for a moment, but ultimately, Sotelato's a problem for them. One with an easy solution."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a burst of static on his..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a burst of static on his end of the line.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sotelato isn't a big threat -- yet.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato isn't a big threat -- yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What you've just implied is ground..."
entries.dialogueText: "What you've just implied is grounds for arrest. Give me one reason why I shouldn't put you behind bars right now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a burst of static on his..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a burst of static on his end of the line.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Huh... You know, I can't actually..."
entries.dialogueText: "Huh... You know, I can't actually think of one."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But just so you know, if you plan..."
entries.dialogueText: "But just so you know, if you plan on reforming the country with his involvement, I'm out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That seems like an extreme measure..."
entries.dialogueText: "That seems like an extreme measure. Nobody's even listening to him."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Yeah, okay. Maybe you're right. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, okay. Maybe you're right. That said..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree that the Sotelato threat m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree that the Sotelato threat must be neutralized. But I don't want to resort to the means you're hinting at."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And as for that money you owe me....."
entries.dialogueText: "And as for that money you owe me... consider your debt repaid."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know that money you owe me? Co..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know that money you owe me? Consider that debt squared."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But should the Crown need assistan..."
entries.dialogueText: "But should the Crown need assistance keeping his movement in check, I'm counting on you to reach out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. I don't need your help..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I don't need your help anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's very kind of you. I'll reme..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very kind of you. I'll remember your words."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough of this talk. You and I hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough of this talk. You and I have a business partnership. That's it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll deal with him on my own. Don'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll deal with him on my own. Don't worry about it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sure, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""On that note, I'm still expecting..."
entries.dialogueText: "On that note, I'm still expecting prompt repayment of the money you owe me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Good luck in Zille.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck in Zille."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Please do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please do."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I wouldn't be calling you if this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be calling you if this wasn't serious. I trust you to handle it."

entries.dialogueText: "Huh. My company has a ledger that says otherwise."

entries.dialogueText: "But it does leave me wondering what my role will be in all this."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've had it with your insolence. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've had it with your insolence. If you know what's good for you, you'll hang up now."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Rewarded how, Your Majesty? You'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rewarded how, Your Majesty? You'll forgive me if I'm a little dense."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll tell you what. Continue to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll tell you what. Continue to be useful to me, and I'll make sure Manus Sazon grants you a cabinet position."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll tell you what. Continue to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll tell you what. Continue to be useful to me, and I'll grant you a seat on my council. Just submit your petition when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom of God will still need..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom of God will still need a financial policy. When the time comes, I will elevate you to your rightful place."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sounds just about perfect, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds just about perfect, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Now we're talking! It's a done dea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now we're talking! It's a done deal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Listen, I remember the promise I m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen, I remember the promise I made to you back then. But I can't guarantee it'll happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I never promised you anything, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never promised you anything, and I'm not about to start now. Be happy with what you've got."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Alright, alright. I won't push my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright, alright. I won't push my luck."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hmm. So the King of Rizia isn't a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. So the King of Rizia isn't a man of his word?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I won't hold it against you, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't hold it against you, Your Majesty. But don't expect any special favors from RRG in the future."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Alright, alright. I won't push my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright, alright. I won't push my luck."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Now that that's settled... is ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that that's settled... is there anything I can do to make both our dreams come true?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I know for a fact you're going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know for a fact you're going to have a tough time getting any reforms past the noble houses."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know what? Never mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know what? Never mind."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Specifically, I want to hear your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Specifically, I want to hear your opinion on a certain rising star in the Rizian parliament."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But as it happens, Antoine and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as it happens, Antoine and the boys of Palantor are specially trained in the art of persuasion."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I've got the boys of Palantor at m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've got the boys of Palantor at my beck and call. Happy to lend them out for any projects too dirty for your Golden Guard to touch."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to know. There may come a tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to know. There may come a time when I am forced to eliminate my rivals."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What kind of a king do you take me..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of a king do you take me for? I would never stoop that low."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The House of Delegates has been ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House of Delegates has been getting in my way of late. Can Palantor assist me in doing away with it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just keep lending me money when I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just keep lending me money when I need it. That's all I ask."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""The bank of Rusty is always open.""
entries.dialogueText: "The bank of Rusty is always open."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On second thought, that seems like..."
entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, that seems like overkill."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""With my connections, I can make su..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my connections, I can make sure the nobles who hold Delegate seats are compensated for their sudden unemployment."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And in the case any RPP members st..."
entries.dialogueText: "And in the case any RPP members start feeling litigious, they'll find every legal expert in the kingdom mysteriously occupied."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shutting down the House of Delegat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Great, Your Majesty. I'll be waiti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great, Your Majesty. I'll be waiting for your signal."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You change your mind, I'll be here..."
entries.dialogueText: "You change your mind, I'll be here by the phone."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Just call me Rusty the Reliable. O..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just call me Rusty the Reliable. Or is that stealing your thing?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds great. I hope I can rely on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds great. I hope I can rely on you when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""They can't, but I can.""
entries.dialogueText: "They can't, but I can."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Believe it or not, my meteoric ris..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe it or not, my meteoric rise at RRG was not accomplished entirely on my lonesome."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""In exchange, I have occasionally a..."
entries.dialogueText: "In exchange, I have occasionally allowed RRG to serve as a financial conduit between those partners and... various other parties."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Early on in my career, certain int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Early on in my career, certain international partners took note of my ambitions and offered their assistance."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And one such set of transactions p..."
entries.dialogueText: "And one such set of transactions proves a definitive link between the country of Lespia and the little incident that derailed the return of Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have proof that Lespia was inv..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have proof that Lespia was involved in the Friendship Day incident?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you're saying you've been worki..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're saying you've been working for Lespia behind my back this whole time?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Were you complicit in the Wehlen b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were you complicit in the Wehlen bombing? Because if you were, lives are on your hands."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I swear I had no idea what I was t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear I had no idea what I was transferring to whom. It was shell corporations inside shell corporations..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But I knew enough to make backup c..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I knew enough to make backup copies of all the paperwork. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm pretty sure I do. I mean, it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm pretty sure I do. I mean, it's shell corporations inside of shell corporations..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But it's all there for someone sma..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm not saying anything of the sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not saying anything of the sort. What I'm trying to tell you is that my loyalties lie with Rizia and Rizia alone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I already know Lespia was behind t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I already know Lespia was behind the bombing, Rusty. Your information means nothing to me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Wait. Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Really?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Then excuse my profanity, but why..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then excuse my profanity, but why the heck haven't you done anything about it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How could you be stupid enough to..."
entries.dialogueText: "How could you be stupid enough to admit this to me?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I wish I could, Your Majesty. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could, Your Majesty. But I can't just saunter out of my house and hand it to you."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""About half of my guards from Palan..."
entries.dialogueText: "About half of my guards from Palantor are guys I trust. The others, well... I don't think they ever worked for me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If I do this for you, they'll neve..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I do this for you, they'll never let me live. You've got to provide me with reinforcements."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I order you to deliver me whatever..."
entries.dialogueText: "I order you to deliver me whatever information you have on Lespia's involvement. Right this instant."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want to upset Rizia's rela..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to upset Rizia's relations with Lespia. This so-called 'evidence' must never see the light of day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want our relations with Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want our relations with Lespia to deteriorate further. This so-called 'evidence' must never see the light of day."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Stupid? I'm taking a leap of faith..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stupid? I'm taking a leap of faith here, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm willing to turn on Lespia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm willing to turn on Lespia and give you the break you need to get back Zille. All so you and I can keep pushing Rizia to economic greatness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what would you expect in retur..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what would you expect in return for this valuable piece of intel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not important. What matters..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not important. What matters is that you just admitted to the King of Rizia that you've been working for foreign interests."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I've got the paperwork stashed som..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've got the paperwork stashed somewhere safe. It's all there for someone smarter than me to decipher."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Only that you and I keep pushing R..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only that you and I keep pushing Rizia to economic greatness, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Well. And that the Crown protect m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. And that the Crown protect me from whatever retaliation my ex-partners have in store."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And that I am willing to use that..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that I am willing to use that work to further the interests of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no way I can keep working..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no way I can keep working with you now, Rusty. I have no choice but to place you under arrest for treason."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Oh... right. Got it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh... right. Got it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could practically hear him rackin..."
entries.dialogueText: I could practically hear him racking his brain over the phone.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Listen, Your Majesty. There are be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen, Your Majesty. There are benefits to me staying on ATO"s good side, too."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I destroyed the evidence I had as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I destroyed the evidence I had as part of an agreement with Prime Minister Alvarez."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's confidential, Mr. Montoro.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's confidential, Mr. Montoro."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Fair enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Such agreements were made to be br..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such agreements were made to be broken, Your Majesty. I'm exhibit A."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Well, shit. And here I thought we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, shit. And here I thought we had a good thing going."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the first time, I became aware..."
entries.dialogueText: For the first time, I became aware of background noises on the other end of the phone. It sounded as if he was at an airport.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Been nice knowing you, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Been nice knowing you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know that money you owe me? Co..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know that money you owe me? Consider that debt squared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By the authority of the Crown, you..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the authority of the Crown, you are now a wanted man."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have a nice life, Rusty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a nice life, Rusty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What?! Where do you think you're g..."
entries.dialogueText: "What?! Where do you think you're going?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Might it be more advantageous for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Might it be more advantageous for you to keep your cover? I can think of a few good uses for a mercenary force like Palantor."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Heh. Your mind works in interestin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heh. Your mind works in interesting ways, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But sure, Antoine and the boys hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "But sure, Antoine and the boys have been complaining that it's been a while since they saw real action. I'm sure they'd be happy to pick up any tasks too dirty for your Golden Guard to touch."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get me the evidence first. Then we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get me the evidence first. Then we'll talk about reinforcements."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's not how it works, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not how it works, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his voice."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his voice.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I stick my neck out any further, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stick my neck out any further, they're going to get suspicious. In fact, I'm calling from my washroom right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That won't be a problem.""
entries.dialogueText: "That won't be a problem."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're rich. Hire protection yours..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're rich. Hire protection yourself."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I knew you'd want in! I'm telling..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew you'd want in! I'm telling you, Your Majesty, this will be a game-changer."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But you're sure you want to pass u..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you're sure you want to pass up the information I'm offering? It'll basically deliver Zille into our hands."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Antoine and the boys of Palantor h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Antoine and the boys of Palantor have been complaining that it's been a while since they saw real action. I'm sure they'd be happy to pick up any tasks too dirty for your Golden Guard to touch."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A mercenary force that can't be co..."
entries.dialogueText: "A mercenary force that can't be connected to the Crown or any noble houses... yes, that might prove useful when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Right? You'll be as good as untouc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right? You'll be as good as untouchable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks, but no thanks. Our busines..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, but no thanks. Our business partnership will stay as it is. I'm going to forget this entire conversation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't weasel your way out of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't weasel your way out of this one, Rusty. You just admitted you're a traitor to the Crown. I have no choice but to put you under arrest."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""What conversation?""
entries.dialogueText: "What conversation?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed loudly."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed loudly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. Get me your evidence an..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. Get me your evidence and the Crown will spare no expense in contracting a new guard force for you."
entries.menuText: "All right. Get me your evidence and the Crown will spare no expense in contracting a new guard force for you." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Send over everything you have on L..."
entries.dialogueText: "Send over everything you have on Lespia and I will send troops  to guarantee your safety."
entries.menuText: "Send over everything you have on Lespia and I will send troops  to guarantee your safety." [-200 Manpower]

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Thank you so much, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you so much, Your Majesty. I promise you I'll deliver."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need that evidence to get..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need that evidence to get Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That paperwork is a liability. Des..."
entries.dialogueText: "That paperwork is a liability. Destroy it at once."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thinking it over, it is a tempting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thinking it over, it is a tempting proposition... And I do have the resources to protect you from Lespia's retaliation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I changed my mind. It's too much r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I changed my mind. It's too much risk for an uncertain reward."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hey, no problem. I was just offeri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, no problem. I was just offering my assistance."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""My guys and I will be around if yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My guys and I will be around if you ever need us."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'll be around if you ever need me.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be around if you ever need me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You don't have to tell me twice. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to tell me twice. Will do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a tempting proposition, but I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a tempting proposition, but I don't have the resources to protect you from Lespia's retaliation."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hey, in that case, forget it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, in that case, forget it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One more thing. The House of Deleg..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more thing. The House of Delegates has been getting in my way of late. Can you assist me in doing away with it?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Just call me Rusty the Reliable. O..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just call me Rusty the Reliable. Or is that stealing your thing?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On second thought, that seems like..."
entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, that seems like overkill."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""With my connections, I can make su..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my connections, I can make sure the nobles who hold Delegate seats are compensated for their sudden unemployment."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And in the case any ex-members sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "And in the case any ex-members start feeling litigious, they'll find every legal expert in the kingdom mysteriously occupied."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shutting down the House of Delegat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shutting down the House of Delegates is a prudent move under the current circumstances, and your assistance would be much appreciated."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Great, Your Majesty. I'll be waiti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great, Your Majesty. I'll be waiting for your signal."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You change your mind, I'll be here..."
entries.dialogueText: "You change your mind, I'll be here by the phone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds great. I hope I can rely on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds great. I hope I can rely on you when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Ha! Glad you asked.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! Glad you asked."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'd better.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'd better."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for your loyalty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for your loyalty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Goodbye, Rusty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Goodbye, Rusty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We hung up."
entries.dialogueText: We hung up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Still holding the receiver, I diale..."
entries.dialogueText: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Lucita and ordered her to place Russello Montoro under special protection.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Titus and ordered him to place Russello Montoro under special protection.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Still holding the receiver, I dialed Taddeus and ordered him to place Russello Montoro under special protection.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lespia would answer for its crimes."
entries.dialogueText: Lespia would answer for its crimes.

entries.dialogueText: "I can get it to you. Maybe not in time for your chat with Smolak, but soon enough."

entries.dialogueText: "I can get it to you. Maybe not in time for your chat with Smolak, but soon."

entries.dialogueText: "I can get it to you. It'll take a while, but I can do it."

entries.dialogueText: "So you're saying you've been working for Lespia behind my back this whole time?"

entries.dialogueText: "I'm not saying anything of the sort. What I'm trying to tell you is that my loyalties lie with Rizia and Rizia alone. And I'll prove it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We know all that already. Did you..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know all that already. Did you know Lespia was trying to undermine us?"

entries.dialogueText: "I swear I had no idea. But get this, Your Majesty..."

entries.dialogueText: "I can get it to you. Not before your meeting with Smolak, but in time to stick it to Lespia later."

entries.dialogueText: "I can get it to you. Not before your meeting with Smolak, but in time to stick it to Lespia later."

entries.dialogueText: Rusty's treason would go unpunished. But Lespia would answer for its crimes.

entries.dialogueText: Rusty's treason would go unpunished. But I had secured his loyalty for life.
